purpose: Compare Jina two-stage full, Jina two-stage PPLX-text, Jina PPLX-budget control, and PPLX two-stage on the frozen BRIGHT cohort.

jina_v3_5.contract: native listwise score then deterministic Top-5

stages.stage1: PPLX frozen per-window budget strings for each candidate view
stages.stage2: prespecified survivor rule and native Jina/PPLX scoring without label access
stages.output: exactly five unique canonical candidate IDs

analysis.metric: known-positive nDCG@5 normalized by min(gold_count, 5); failed request scores 0
primary_contrasts: pplx_two_stage - jina_two_stage_full on original BM25 order
pplx_two_stage - jina_two_stage_full on mean of six shuffled orders
pplx_two_stage - jina_two_stage_pplxtext on original BM25 order
jina_two_stage_full - jina_full on original BM25 order
analysis.multiple_testing: Holm adjustment over the four primary contrasts

timing.required: dedicated A100 session for complete selector timing
timing.measure: preprocessing + native scoring + selection + output packaging
timing.determinism: 20 random non-timing requests rerun after the timing session

gate.reason: No candidate GPU was both free of resident workloads and valid for a dedicated matched timing session at preflight.
gate.next_action: Do not infer C1 results from historical outputs; rerun only after a dedicated-device gate passes.
